text:
Priya N.: hey folks, day 1! quick practical list: where should i post these so i don't annoy people? 1) badge/laptop request 2) expense receipt 3) PTO question 4) quick PR review ask 5) daily CI noise 6) vendor pickup. also how do i silence bots but still get direct mentions?

IT-Support: welcome Priya! compact map: #help = badge/laptop/accounts; #finance = expenses (use the expense app, don't paste receipts); #people-ops = PTO/HR questions; #eng-code-reviews = cross-team PR links; #ci-notifications = CI events; #people-ops or #facilities = vendor pickups.

IT-Support: short etiquette: use threads for follow-ups, react with :eyes: or :white_check_mark: instead of "thanks", avoid @channel unless it's urgent.

Oliver (People Ops): also pin the onboarding doc in #new-hires and react to the welcome message to opt into the onboarding flow. Use the PTO app for formal requests (it tracks approvals).

Maya Eng: PR review workflow: drop the PR link and a 1-line summary. If you need a fast review, add :zap: and tag the reviewer in the PR. Avoid pasting logs; use gist/artifact links.

Priya N.: bots: i get standup + ci + deploy messages. can i hide them but keep mentions?

IT-Support: yes — open channel > Notification preferences > Mentions & reactions -> turn off "All new messages", keep "Mentions & keywords" and "Replies to threads you're in". Add your full name as a keyword if people mention you informally. For noisy bots, request owners to move non-critical posts to #ci-notifications; keep only failures/alerts in main channels.

ops-bot: Daily standup: 1) Blockers: none 2) Today: onboarding 3) Help: access requests (posted to #new-hires)

Priya N.: great, i'll post badge in #help and lunch in #random. one more: when's it OK to create a new channel?

Maya Eng: create a channel if >3 people need continuous coordination or the topic would spam others. Make it private if it's just your pod. Add a short purpose and pin docs.

IT-Support: if any bot keeps spamming, file a request in #help and we can reconfigure webhooks or add filters so only failures route to main channels.

Priya N.: thanks all! this cleared things up :raised_hands: joining #new-hires now
